eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 3:03 AM on JUL 28, 2026 Effective until 11:03 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A SAFE Alert has been issued for Maricopa County. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. Mesa Police Department is looking for Manual Shaw Native American Male, 5 feet 7 inches, 225 pounds, gray hair, black eyes, last seen wearing a red t-shirt, blue shorts, long black socks, and white shoes. Manual was last seen on 07/27/2026 at 9:30 PM in the area of Main Street and Extension Road when he left his residence on foot. Manual suffers from a medical condition that can make him become easily confused. Anyone with information on his whereabouts is asked to call Mesa Police Department. If you have contact with this SAFE Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
